hints.title: Exhaustive Bitmask Assignment
hints.text: Since n is at most 15, enumerate all 2^n possible assignments of good (1) and bad (0) people using integer bitmasks.

hints.title: Verify Statements of Good People
hints.text: For a chosen mask, only statements made by people designated as good must strictly match the assignment.

hints.title: Maximize Population
hints.text: Among all consistent configurations, find the maximum number of set bits (count of good people).

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Logical deduction with contradictions without systematic enumeration becomes entangled with cycles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 2^N bitmask search with N <= 15 takes O(2^N * N^2) operations and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize small N constraint and evaluate truth consistency under bitmask assignments.
